basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 26-year-old tech enthusiast from San Francisco. I recently started exploring Reddit to dive deeper into my interests in fiber optics and the law of attraction. When I'm not online, I work as an entry-level technician at a local telecommunications company. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings learning new things or playing casual games. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch breaks or late at night after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, which sparked my interest in fiber optics. Most of my knowledge comes from formal education and hands-on experience at my job. I'm also self-teaching myself about the law of attraction through online resources and community discussions.
